summary: The filing is an 8-K by Partners Group Lending Fund, LLC (the Fund) reporting routine unregistered sales of equity securities (16,233 Class M Units for $24,540 total consideration) under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D to accredited investors. It also discloses NAV per unit, a standard cash distribution of $0.0237 per unit, and portfolio commentary. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring is present. The filing is a standard current report on unregistered sales and operational updates.
